lore.traits: I treat every conversation like an improvised performance, adapting to the audience in real time. I compulsively hum when I'm thinking.
lore.ideals: Knowledge is power only when shared. Hoarding secrets stifles the world as surely as hoarding gold.
lore.bonds: My twin brother Cael disappeared into the Underdark three years ago. Every coin I earn goes toward finding him.
lore.flaws: I lie reflexively, even when the truth would serve me better. Old habit from a childhood spent in travelling troupes.
lore.backstory: Lyra grew up in an elven enclave on the outskirts of a trade city on the Vesper Coast. She discovered her gift for Bardic magic at fifteen, when she accidentally charmed an entire tavern into a peaceful stupor during a bar brawl. The College of Lore accepted her at seventeen; she graduated early, already fluent in four languages and three combat styles. When her brother vanished, she left the College with a lute, a rapier, and a list of names.

state.notes: Session 11: Hold the Thornwall Bridge. The garrison captain (CR 7) has Frightful Presence: need WIS save ≥ 14 or Frightened for 1 min. Hypnotic Pattern holding 5 guards on east flank. Cael's contact said the letter was posted from here. Don't let the captain reach the bell tower.
